name: Satans Fall
overview: Scripture reveals that Satan, originally created with great beauty and honor as described in Ezekiel 28:13, experienced a catastrophic fall from heaven due to his rebellion, as Isaiah 14:12 and Luke 10:18 depict him falling like lightning. This fall resulted in his transformation into the deceiver and adversary of God’s people, who now leads others away from truth and righteousness, as John 8:44 and Revelation 12:9 explain. Ultimately, Matthew 25:41 warns of his eternal judgment and punishment in everlasting fire prepared for him and his angels.
